text:
Zoe: Dropping a compact "field pocket" draft — 1 page that sales can use in demos. Focus: Security + SLA options across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need: 30s hook, 3 quick decision signals, tiny benchmark line, compliance bullets, CTA. Link: https://docs.google.com/field-pocket (internal)
Ravi: Nice. Suggest a 3-row tradeoff table: latency | cost predictability | data control. One short phrase per cell.
Maya: Add customer signals under each mode (3 bullets): e.g., Hosted = "pilot, fast launch"; Dedicated = "predictable throughput"; Private = "regulated or air-gapped"
Connor: Benchmarks: paste p95 short-chat latencies for each mode and a back-of-envelope cost delta vs Hosted. One-line panel.
Lili: Compliance: call out KMS/HSM, SOC2, optional on-prem air-gap. Keep language non-legal. Also include a one-line escalation path for SLA breaches.
Zoe: I put a micro-ops snippet for regional failover and canary. Can we include code sample? Sales likes concrete config examples.
Ravi: Small YAML please, something like:
```yaml
canary:
  percent: 10
  watch: 30m
  fallback: true
```
Maya: Good. For the webinar snip, create a 3-slide outline: problem, how Redwood solves it (runtime + routing), customer story + CTA. Landing page needs 2 bullets only.
Connor: I'll flatten the 10k/day ecomm and 50k/day finserv bench numbers into one sentence each and paste them into the doc.
Lili: Tone edits: soften any absolute guarantees. Use "target SLA" and "escalation path: field support -> 1hr P1 response"
Zoe: CTA idea: "Book a 20-min field demo" + checkbox to qualify for Dedicated trial. Also add a one-line procurement bullet: estimated delta vs Hosted.
Ravi: For inbound routing, I'll export tags for SalesOps: deploy_mode=hosted/dedicated/private and interest=security/sla/perf.
Maya: Can someone make a 3-bullet webinar registration blurb? I'll draft: 1) Balance latency & compliance, 2) Real failover patterns, 3) Live benchmark + Q&A
Connor: Timeline: need final PDF by Friday AM for the email batch. Who can finish copy by Thu EOD?
Zoe: I'll merge edits Wed evening and drop the final PDF Thu morning. Thanks all :rocket:
deploy-bot: Note: linked doc was updated 2 hours ago by Zoe
Lili: I'll sign off compliance by Thu 6pm.
Ravi: I'll hand off the tagging CSV to SalesOps Thu noon.
Maya: I'll prep the 30s webinar host notes Thu evening.
Zoe: Great — next sync Thu 10am.
